data.one_liner: Customizable Flutter color picker widget with material palettes, custom swatches, and HSV wheel.
data.what_it_does: FlexColorPicker provides a versatile color picker for Flutter apps, supporting Material primary and accent swatches, near black and white, custom swatches, and an HSV color wheel. It includes options for tonal palettes, opacity sliders, color code copy-paste, and built-in dialog methods.
use_when: You need a comprehensive color picker widget in your Flutter application.
You want users to select colors from Material swatches, custom swatches, or an HSV color wheel.
avoid_when: Your app does not target Flutter 3.47 or later (required for v4.0.0).
strengths: Supports multiple picker types including Material, custom swatches, and HSV wheel
Includes built-in dialog methods and copy-paste behavior with keyboard shortcuts
Highly customizable item shapes, sizes, and layout
weaknesses: Requires Flutter 3.47.0 or higher and standalone material_ui/cupertino_ui dependencies
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and import the package. Requires Flutter 3.47.0+.

alternatives.name: flutter_colorpicker
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you need a simpler or different color picker implementation without the specific features or Material 3 tonal palette generation of FlexColorPicker.

data.minimal_example:
ColorPicker(
  color: screenPickerColor,
  onColorChanged: (Color color) => setState(() => screenPickerColor = color),
  width: 44,
  height: 44,
  borderRadius: 22,
  heading: Text('Select color', style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.headlineSmall),
  subheading: Text('Select color shade', style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleSmall),
)
